title: InternalChannelConfiguration
description: Closed deployment-local configuration for one authenticated internal service channel. This is not an Arkret wire object. It binds the credential verifier to one source service, one destination service, one trust domain, an exact operation allowlist, and an explicit integrity posture. See zh/sync/service-http-binding.md section 2.2.3 and ak.vector.internal_channel.authorization_and_integrity.v1.

credential_key_ids.description: Deployment-local identifiers of credential verification keys accepted for this exact channel binding. Secret key material is never carried here or on the wire.

allowed_operations.description: Exact per-channel operation allowlist. Route-family or prefix grants are forbidden.

integrity.description: Required declaration of why the internal channel may replace operation-listed RFC 9421 protection. Absence or invalidity grants no unsigned internal contract.

decrypting_forwarding_proxies.description: Complete ordered-independent set of stable deployment-local proxy identifiers for every TLS-decrypting or request-forwarding intermediary in the channel. Entries are already trimmed and therefore cannot differ only by surrounding whitespace.
